description: Mark or unmark up to 100 products for one connected sales channel (prom, rozetka, ebay, olx, …). It changes what the CRM intends to send: on Prom and Rozetka the next feed pull adds or drops the product; on eBay it only makes the product a channel member — a listing exists only after create_ebay_drafts and publish_ebay_drafts. It never arms a sync. Adding picks up active products only. Returns { affected, skipped } — skipped were already in that state. Refused until the workspace owner switches on AI publishing. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

listed.description: true marks the products for this channel; false unmarks them. This only changes what the CRM intends to send — it never arms a sync and never creates a listing by itself. Unmarking a product on Prom drops it from the next feed pull.

platform.description: The connected sales channel to change membership on (e.g. prom, rozetka, ebay, olx).

productIds.description: The exact products to change, at most 100 ids fetched with search_products.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.
